bullets.text: Built SQL pipelines aggregating 12M rows of transaction data into daily reporting tables
Automated a weekly Excel report in Python, cutting manual effort from 6 hours to 10 minutes
Built Tableau dashboards tracking retention across 4 customer segments
Wrote pandas transformations to clean and deduplicate a 2M-row customer table
Investigated a reporting discrepancy and traced it to a timezone bug in the ETL job
Presented weekly findings to a team of 8 including two product managers
Documented 15 recurring queries into a shared runbook used by the analytics team
Added data quality checks that caught 3 upstream schema changes before release
Trained a gradient boosting churn classifier reaching 0.87 ROC-AUC on held-out data
Engineered 24 behavioural features from raw event logs using pandas
Compared logistic regression, random forest and XGBoost across 5-fold cross-validation
Deployed the model behind a FastAPI endpoint containerised with Docker
Wrote a SHAP-based explanation layer surfacing the top 5 drivers per prediction
Set up MLflow to track 40+ experiment runs and their hyperparameters
Documented the full pipeline in a README with reproducible setup steps
Reduced inference latency from 340ms to 45ms by batching feature lookups
